```yaml
name: OpenData Commitment Eligibility

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Java JDK 11
      uses: actions/setup-java@v2
      with:
        java-version: '11'
        distribution: 'adopt'

    - name: Set up Maven
      uses: stCarolas/setup-maven@v5
      with:
        maven-version: '3.8.4'

    - name: Run lint tests
      run: mvn clean verify -DskipTests=true

    - name: Run unit tests
      run: mvn test

    - name: Publish Surefire Report
      uses: ScalableCapital/action-surefire-report@v2
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        report_paths: '**/target/surefire-reports/*.xml'
        create_check: true
        check_name: 'Unit Tests'
        commit: true
        fail_on_test_failures: true
        fail_if_no_tests: false
        ignore_flaky_tests: false
        skip_publishing: false
        file_name_in_stack_trace: true
        github_base_url: https://api.github.com
        custom_summary: 'Unit test results'

  deploy:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Deploy to Azure Static Web Apps
      uses: Azure/static-web-apps-deploy@v1
      with:
        action: 'upload'
        app_location: './dist'
        azure_static_web_apps_api_token: ${{ secrets.AZURE_STATIC_WEB_APPS_API_TOKEN }}
        production_branch: main
        skip_app_build: true
        skip_api_build: true

  document:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Create project card
      uses: actions/add-to-project@v1.0.2
      with:
        project-url: https://github.com/microsoft/finops-toolkit/projects/1
        github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        labeled: 'Documentation'
        label-operator: 'in'
```
